item.title: State College Borough Council Appoints New Member
item.description: A State College resident with a long history of civic involvement was appointed on Monday night to the Borough Council. The sitting members of council selected Susan Venegoni to fill the vacancy created when Josh Portney stepped down in January. She will serve the remainder of Portney's elected term ending Dec. 31, 2027. Venegoni was among six residents who applied for the seat and gave 10-minute presentations on Monday night. item.title: Penn State DC D’Anton Lynn Shares His Coaching Philosophy
item.description: Former Penn State cornerback D’Anton Lynn has quickly risen up the coaching ranks, going from an intern with the New York Jets in 2014 to UCLA’s defensive coordinator in 2023. item.title: United, American Increasing Daily Flights From State College Regional Airport
item.description: Two commercial airlines will soon be increasing their daily number of flights to established destinations from State College Regional Airport. Beginning March 30, United Airlines will operate up to six flights most days to Chicago O'Hare International (up from the typical four currently offered), and four flights to Dulles International (up from the current three), according to a release from the airport on Tuesday. item.title: Penn State Student Remains on Life Support After Hit-and-Run in State College, Family Says
item.description: A Penn State student who was critically injured in a hit-and-run crash early Saturday morning in State College remains on life support and is expected to be in an intensive care unit for at least a month, according to a GoFundMe campaign established by her family. item.title: Centre Region Townships Receive $540K in State Funds for Traffic Safety Improvements
item.description: Two Centre Region townships will receive a combined $540,765 in state grant funding for transportation safety improvement projects, PennDOT announced on Tuesday.
